caption: Gemeenteweg, Staphorst
composition: Ribbon of thatched hall-farms along the village road at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Gemeenteweg at Staphorst is a long row of hall-farms. Each short gable faces the road: whitewashed brick, a thatched wolf roof, green shutters, and a blue plinth, with a weatherboard barn behind. The museum farm is closed. It is overcast, about 10.0°C, with wind near 4.0 km/h and cloud cover about 93%. No one in regional dress is shown. Late September, no snow. Giethoorn is another village and is not in this frame.
